verdict.rationale: Alloy is a hosted SaaS identity and fraud-decisioning platform, so data residency and cross-border handling are fair questions for a buyer. The evidence pack never documents a processing region, data-residency options, or cross-border transfer terms. The sandbox-vs-production note on a shared data store concerns logical modes, not geographic processing location, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
